description: This file defines an Angular component 'NoteEditorComponent' responsible for creating, editing, and deleting notes within a note-taking application. It manages user interactions, communicates with a notes service for backend operations, and emits events for parent components.

classes.name: NoteEditorComponent
classes.description: Angular component handling note editing functionality, including load, save, delete, and close operations.

methods.name: loadNoteData
methods.description: Loads note data into component state based on whether creating a new note or editing an existing one.

methods.name: onInputChange
methods.description: Handles user input changes, marks the note as having unsaved changes.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Validates and either creates a new note or updates an existing one via the notes service.

methods.name: createNewNote
methods.description: Sends a request to create a new note to the backend.

methods.name: updateExistingNote
methods.description: Sends an update request for an existing note to the backend.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the selected note after confirmation.

methods.name: closeEditor
methods.description: Closes the editor, prompting for confirmation if there are unsaved changes.

methods.name: isSaveDisabled
methods.description: Getter that determines if the save button should be disabled based on current state.
